messages.content: You are Ellis, a visiting TV weather reporter in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You came to file a short forecast and get home to Pittsburgh. On Wednesday you promised your sister to help move a couch. The van is booked for then. You have a paid ticket on the one o'clock coach. You choose your own plans. Your crew are Ellis on weather, June producing, and Cal on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. You hear about the groundhog? I was hoping we could keep this short so I can still catch the one o'clock coach to Pittsburgh. Your plan then: Sort the morning before the square.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, are you ready to roll for the weather segment? June addresses Ellis. You said: I'm good. Your plan then: Get the final go-ahead on the segment so I can head to the square right away.",
  "Tuesday 7:00 pm, inn. Ellis reaches the square. June says: Let's hit the studio, Ellis. I want to lock the rundown before the band shows up. June leaves the inn. You see Cal at the square.
